ctgov.note: No registered interventional Phase 1-3 trials sponsored by issuer

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Prestige Consumer Healthcare is a marketer and distributor of branded over-the-counter consumer healthcare products (e.g., BC/Goody's, Clear Eyes, Compound W, Dramamine, Monistat, Nix, Summer's Eve, Hydralyte, Boudreaux's Butt Paste). It is a commercial-stage consumer-products company and does not develop or sponsor human Phase 1/2/3 clinical trials. Out of scope for biotech-pipeline tracking.
